title: Quantum-inspired orthogonal adapters for certifiably robust medical image classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.18775v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image classifiers require not only high accuracy but also reliable predictions under small input perturbations. Certified robustness provides mathematical guarantees of prediction stability, but preserving these guarantees when adapting pretrained models to new tasks remains challenging. We propose a fine-tuning approach based on quantum-inspired orthogonal butterfly layers that preserves the Lipschitz bounds of pretrained certified networks. Inspired by quantum circuits of reconfigurable beam splitters, these layers preserve orthogonality by construction using only $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ trainable parameters. Their structured design enables efficient classical implementation and offers a path toward future quantum implementations with logarithmic circuit depth under suitable connectivity assumptions. Controlled experiments on MNIST and MedMNIST demonstrate improved certified robustness compared with conventional alternatives a

translated_title: 面向可认证鲁棒医学图像分类的量子启发正交适配器
translated_abstract: 医学图像分类器不仅需要高精度，还需要在小输入扰动下保持可靠的预测。认证鲁棒性为预测稳定性提供了数学保证，但在将预训练模型适配到新任务时保持这些保证仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于量子启发正交蝶形层的微调方法，该方法能够保持预训练认证网络的Lipschitz界。受可重构分束器量子电路的启发，这些层通过构造方式保持正交性，仅使用O(n log n)个可训练参数。其结构化设计支持高效的经典实现，并在适当的连接性假设下，为未来以对数电路深度实现量子化提供了途径。在MNIST和MedMNIST上的对照实验表明，与传统替代方法相比，该方法展现出更优的认证鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种基于量子启发正交蝶形层的微调方法，仅用O(n log n)个可训练参数即可在适配预训练模型到新任务时保持Lipschitz界，从而在医学图像分类中显著提升认证鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: A fine-tuning approach based on quantum-inspired orthogonal butterfly layers preserves the Lipschitz bounds of pretrained certified networks with only O(n log n) trainable parameters, achieving improved certified robustness in medical image classification.
